l.zh: 7 奈米及更先進製程占台積電 2025 年晶圓銷售（2024 年是 69%）
l.en: Share of TSMC’s 2025 wafer revenue from 7-nanometre and more advanced processes (69% in 2024)

l.zh: 高效能運算平台占台積電 2025 年營收（2023 年是 43%）
l.en: Share of TSMC’s 2025 revenue from the high-performance-computing platform (43% in 2023)

l.zh: TrendForce 估 2024 年台灣占全球晶圓代工產能；16/14 奈米及更先進製程是 66%
l.en: TrendForce’s estimate of Taiwan’s share of global foundry capacity in 2024; 66% for 16/14-nanometre and more advanced processes

l.zh: 台積電 2025 年底全球員工數
l.en: TSMC employees worldwide at the end of 2025

t.zh: 半導體製造的規模：2025 年 IC 產業產值 6.52 兆元，其中晶圓代工 4.17 兆元。
t.en: Scale in chip manufacturing: IC industry output of NT$6.52 trillion in 2025, of which foundry was NT$4.17 trillion.

t.zh: 先進製程的產能大半在台灣：TrendForce 估 2024 年台灣占全球 16/14 奈米及更先進製程產能的 66%。
t.en: Most leading-edge capacity is in Taiwan: TrendForce put Taiwan at 66% of global capacity at 16/14 nanometres and below in 2024.

t.zh: 從晶片到整機都有人做：資通與視聽產品 2025 年占出口 39.2%，電子零組件占 34.7%。
t.en: Everything from chip to finished system is made here: ICT and audio-video products were 39.2% of 2025 exports and electronic components 34.7%.

t.zh: 三個科學園區 2025 年營業額 5.80 兆元，從業員工 34 萬人，新的基地還在核定。
t.en: The three science parks made NT$5.80 trillion in 2025 with 340,000 employees, and new bases are still being approved.

t.zh: 整體經濟跟著成長：主計總處統計 2025 年經濟成長率 8.76%。
t.en: The economy as a whole has grown with it: 8.76% in 2025 by DGBAS figures.

t.zh: 出口集中在一類產品與一個市場：2025 年 74% 是電子零組件與資通產品，31% 賣到美國。
t.en: Exports are concentrated in one kind of product and one market: 74% electronic components and ICT products in 2025, and 31% sold to the United States.

t.zh: 市值集中在一家公司：台積電占上市櫃市值 38%，電子產業占上市股價指數權重 76%。
t.en: Market value is concentrated in one company: TSMC is 38% of the listed market, and electronics is 76% of the TWSE index by weight.

t.zh: 電：能源署預估 2026 到 2035 年用電需求年均成長 2.5%，是過去十年的兩倍。
t.en: Power: the Energy Administration projects electricity demand to grow 2.5% a year from 2026 to 2035, twice the pace of the past decade.

t.zh: 傳統製造業的份量在縮：占製造業產值從 2017 年的 62.7% 降到 2024 年的 53.7%（央行整理）。
t.en: Traditional manufacturing is shrinking in weight: from 62.7% of manufacturing output in 2017 to 53.7% in 2024 (central bank compilation).

t.zh: 地理上也集中：工廠營收的四分之三落在六個縣市。
t.en: It is concentrated geographically too: three-quarters of factory revenue is in six counties and cities.

t.zh: 先進製程的占比預估會降：TrendForce 估 2027 年台灣在 16/14 奈米及更先進製程產能的占比從 66% 降到 55%。
t.en: The leading-edge share is projected to fall: TrendForce expects Taiwan’s share of capacity at 16/14 nanometres and below to drop from 66% to 55% by 2027.

t.zh: 台積電亞利桑那：累計投資規劃 1,650 億美元（2025 年 3 月公告）。年報寫第二座晶圓廠預計 2027 年下半年量產。
t.en: TSMC Arizona: cumulative planned investment of US$165 billion (announced March 2025). The annual report expects the second fab to enter volume production in the second half of 2027.

t.zh: 台積電熊本：第二座晶圓廠 2025 年開始興建，年報寫規劃採用 3 奈米製程。
t.en: TSMC Kumamoto: construction of the second fab began in 2025; the annual report says it is planned for 3-nanometre technology.

t.zh: 租稅優惠的期限：產業創新條例的研發與設備投資抵減，多數條文適用到 2029 年 12 月 31 日。
t.en: The tax incentives have an end date: most R&D and equipment credits in the Statute for Industrial Innovation apply until 31 December 2029.

t.zh: 美國的半導體 232 調查：第一階段 2026 年 1 月公告，第二階段還沒有官方結果。行政院的說明是臺美協定已載明臺灣取得最優惠待遇，具體稅率未公告。
t.en: The US Section 232 semiconductor investigation: phase one was proclaimed in January 2026; phase two has no official outcome yet. The Executive Yuan says the Taiwan–US agreement secures most-favoured treatment for Taiwan, with no specific rate announced.

t.zh: 科學園區繼續往南：南科的屏東、嘉義園區 2022 年核定，楠梓園區 2023 年核定，沙崙園區 2025 年 12 月核定。
t.en: Science parks keep moving south: the Southern park’s Pingtung and Chiayi bases were approved in 2022, Nanzih in 2023 and Shalun in December 2025.

t.zh: 中小微企業：行政院 2026 年 9 月的規劃是八年內再投入 1,000 億元到轉型升級發展基金。
t.en: Small firms: the Executive Yuan’s September 2026 plan is to add NT$100 billion over eight years to a transformation and upgrading fund.
TSMC’s renewable-energy targets: 60% by 2030 and 100% by 2040; the 2025 figure was 20.1%.
